name: gpt-pilot
description: The first real AI developer — builds production apps from scratch
summary: AI coding agent that builds full production applications from natural language specs. Uses LLMs to plan, code, debug, and deploy complete apps with minimal human input. Built in Python.
readme_snippet:
GPT Pilot is an AI developer that builds production-ready apps.

## How it works
1. You describe your app
2. GPT Pilot plans the architecture
3. It codes each component
4. Tests everything
5. Deploys

## Features
- Full-stack apps (React, Node, Python)
- Database design & migrations
- Testing & debugging
- Deployment scripts

name: sglang
description: SGLang is a fast serving framework for large language models and vision-language models
summary: High-performance LLM serving framework with structured generation. Achieves 5x faster inference than vLLM on certain workloads with its RadixAttention mechanism. Built in Python.

name: smolagents
description: Minimal framework for building powerful agents with code execution
summary: Lightweight agent framework from Hugging Face. Agents write and execute Python code to solve tasks. Supports any LLM backend. Code-first design means agents actually work.

name: open-reasoner-zero
description: Open source implementation of DeepSeek-R1 style reasoning with RL
summary: Open reproduction of DeepSeek-R1 reasoning capabilities using reinforcement learning. Achieves strong reasoning with open models, narrowing the gap with proprietary systems.

name: llama-cpp-agent
description: Easy-to-use AI agent framework built on llama-cpp-python
summary: Agent framework for local LLMs. Function calling, memory, RAG, and web search — all running locally with quantized models on consumer hardware.

name: whisper-turbo
description: 50x faster Whisper inference with speculative decoding
summary: Radically faster Whisper speech recognition using speculative decoding. Real-time transcription on consumer GPUs. Drop-in replacement for OpenAI Whisper.

name: agentmemory
description: Persistent memory for AI coding agents — 95.2% retrieval accuracy
summary: Cross-session memory engine for AI coding agents. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and OpenClaw. BM25+Vector+Graph hybrid search with auto-forget.

name: jan-ai
description: Open source ChatGPT alternative that runs 100% offline
summary: Desktop app for running LLMs locally. Clean UI, model library, and inference engine. Supports GGUF models. Open source alternative to ChatGPT desktop.

name: llama.cpp
description: LLM inference in C/C++ — the backbone of local AI
summary: The foundational C/C++ library for local LLM inference. Powers most local AI tools. Runs anywhere — CPU, GPU, mobile. Supports GGUF quantized models.

name: crawl4ai
description: Open-source LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper
summary: LLM-optimized web crawler that extracts clean, structured content. Perfect for RAG pipelines. Handles JS rendering, authentication, and structured output formats.

name: vision-agent
description: Vision AI agent that codes computer vision solutions
summary: AI agent that generates complete computer vision solutions from natural language. Codes, trains, and deploys vision models. Handles image classification, detection, and segmentation.

name: qwen3
description: Qwen3: New generation of language models with thinking and tool use
summary: Next-gen LLM from Alibaba with native thinking/reasoning modes. Supports multimodal understanding, tool calling, and code execution. State-of-the-art on multiple benchmarks.
